heading: Wednesday, January 28, 2026
topLine: xAI launches Grok Imagine video generation API.

items.headline: xAI launches Grok Imagine video generation API
items.summary: xAI released the Grok Imagine API, which it calls its most powerful video-audio generative model, for text- and image-to-video generation with native audio and video editing. xAI reports it ranked first on Artificial Analysis's text-to-video leaderboard at launch.
